create property graph.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH khg VERTEX TABLES (node LABEL nd, fact LABEL ver) EDGE TABLES (binds SOURCE KEY (vk) REFERENCES fact (vk) DESTINATION KEY (ref) REFERENCES node (id) LABEL binds)

incident ex:KingOfFrance.sql: FROM GRAPH_TABLE (khg MATCH (v:ver)-[b:binds]->(n:nd WHERE n.id = 'ex:KingOfFrance') WHERE v.status = 'asserted' AND v.tx_to IS NULL COLUMNS (v.id AS id, b.role AS role)) ORDER BY id

find agent insulin + metformin (two edge.sql: FROM GRAPH_TABLE (khg MATCH (a:nd WHERE a.id = 'ex:insulin')<-[b1:binds WHERE b1.role = 'agent']-(v:ver) -[b2:binds WHERE b2.role = 'agent']->(c:nd WHERE c.id = 'ex:metformin') WHERE v.relation = 'co_administration_causes' AND b1.bid <> b2.bid COLUMNS (v.id AS id))

walk one level (superseded <- khg:supers.sql: FROM GRAPH_TABLE (khg MATCH (a:nd WHERE a.id = 'f:born-skłodowska-kraków')<-[x:binds WHERE x.role = 'khg:superseded']- (s:ver WHERE s.relation = 'khg:supersedes' AND s.status = 'asserted')-[y:binds WHERE y.role = 'khg:superseding']->(b:nd) COLUMNS (s.id AS via, b.id AS dst))

walk as a variable-length path (any shor.error: Constraint Error: Non-existent/non-unique vertices detected. Make sure all vertices referred by edge tables exist and are unique for path-finding queries.
walk as a variable-length path (any shor.sql: FROM GRAPH_TABLE (khg MATCH p = ANY SHORTEST (a:nd WHERE a.id = 'f:born-skłodowska-kraków')-[e:binds]-{1,8} (b:nd WHERE b.id = 'f:born-skłodowska-warszawa') COLUMNS (path_length(p) AS hops))
